flags.name: San Pellegrino 500ml
flags.issue: WRONG PACK UNIT, and a stale seed price — the same 'can' defect flagged across ~30 spirits in the 2026-08-15 review, recurring on a soft drink. The row is 1 'can' at $2.3200 with pack_qty 1, so the 500 mL volume is lost and the item is costed per container while the picker's other sparkling water ("Version Two Sparkling - Bottle") is costed per ml. 'can' is also factually wrong: ILG invoices this exact product as raw_uom '24x500ML' (ILG code 450-1293, 'S.PELLEGRINO SPARKLING WATER'), i.e. a 500 mL bottle sold 24 to a carton — San Pellegrino's can format is 330 mL. Separately the $2.3200 is a Back Office seed dated 2026-01-01 (source_invoice 'bo-seed-harry_gatos'), while real invoiced prices run through July: $2.3179 (03690691, 2026-05-05), $2.6704 (03701256, 2026-05-21), $2.3175 (03714643, 2026-06-16), $2.3558 (03729959, 2026-07-14). needs_pack_review is FALSE, so nothing else will surface either problem.
flags.suggested_fix: Set pack_qty 500 and pack_unit 'ml' (cost_per_base_unit ~$0.004712/ml at ILG's latest $2.3558), matching how the other sparkling water is stored. The 500 mL pack size is CONFIRMED from our own ILG invoices (raw_uom '24x500ML' on four invoices May-July 2026) and was NOT guessed. Also consider preferring the invoiced ILG price over the January BO seed — a seven-month-old seed cost sitting in front of four newer invoiced observations is the same staleness that the bo-seed rows keep reintroducing. NOT auto-applied; changing pack basis moves every recipe that picks this item, so Zak should confirm before it ships.

flags.name: Roasted Red Peppers [A12]
flags.issue: WEIGHT-LESS PACK on a product recipes measure by mass. The row is 1 'ea' at $14.00 with needs_pack_review FALSE, so a recipe adding e.g. 100 g of pepper strips cannot be costed — it can only book a whole tin. Every other pepper/capsicum entry in the picker is costed per gram. The inconsistency is visible inside the feed itself: the direct-supplier sibling, Gulli 'Sapore- Roasted Red Peppers Strips A12' (code SAPPEPSTRIPA12-UC3), carries needs_pack_review TRUE and is already going to the chef, but this bridged Lightspeed copy of the same tin (cost book note: 'confirmed bridge from Gulli SAPPEPSTRIPA12-UC3') is not. Confirmed same product and same price: $14.00 per tin on Gulli invoices CI-381145, CI-384734, CI-388562, CI-391775 (Apr-May 2026). The cost itself is correct.
flags.suggested_fix: Needs the A12 tin's net/drained weight so it can be costed per gram, then pack_qty <net grams> / pack_unit 'g'. THE WEIGHT WAS NOT GUESSED AND IS NOT IN OUR DATA: the Gulli invoice line states raw_uom None and pack 1, and no weight appears anywhere on the document — partly because parsers/gulli.py discards the UOM column entirely (raw_uom is hard-set None; see parser_regression.py TRIAGE LOG item 24). 'A12' is a trade can-size code, but this review will not convert it to a weight without a source. Zak or the chef to confirm the tin's net weight from the Sapore label or the Gulli catalogue. Failing that, set needs_pack_review TRUE so it reaches the chef the way its Gulli sibling already does.
